scope: Bounded posthoc recipe search on nine current-policy failures from the historical fixed 7x5 grid. Two fixed-base clearance blockers remain explicitly blocked; 24 successful current recipes are replayed without changing their joints. Bucket-facing yaw, native64/v3, whole-ball one-second capture including table/rim assistance. Three fresh nominal repeats confirm a discovered recipe. No policy fitting, PPO, new positions, bucket perturbations, noise, 128-step qualification, learned transit, hardware or policy promotion.

raw_protocol.evaluation_scope: historical fixed-grid recipe development; not held out and not a new policy score
raw_protocol.search_order: 80 frozen proposals per case, round-robin one per active case; no flight-dependent numeric changes
raw_protocol.confirmation: Immediately repeat each captured discovery three times; stop a case after 3/3 or three failed confirmation groups
raw_protocol.timing: Stop starting search rounds after 5400 acquired seconds; finish selected repeats and final controls within 7200 seconds
raw_protocol.preservation: All24 current captured recipes replay once with authenticated unchanged action and joint branch
